intro: Blackwood Lake is a blighted body of water situated in the southern Eastern Plaguelands, teeming with hostile, corrupted elementals. The area is haunted by memories of tragedy and war, watched over by a small frontline camp of the Argent Dawn.

p: Like so much of the Eastweald, Blackwood Lake has been poisoned by the rampant plague of undeath. Diseased and foul water elementals churn beneath the murky surface, attacking anyone who ventures near the shoreline.
